round_upgrades.notes: If the enemy has a DVA or rein that you fear might block a lot of your helix rockets, this is also a good first round pick to provide you a little extra survivability when you’re getting dove. I always take this and Hunkered Down as the first two powers due to their synergy. Come round 3, Every time you helix rocket, you will get a healing station down and overhealth. The overhealth received from Helix rocket also stacks with your healing station ability. So you get double.

Damage is still king on this build so that you can continue to kill things as you get later and later into the game. Early rounds have more of an emphasis on Survivability though to allow you to stay in the fights longer and doing more sustained damage due to that.

Lifesteal is something you should always have at least 1 item of in your build at all times. While you’re doing damage you will be repairing your armor back onto yourself to refresh your damage reduction.

Armor is incredibly strong in stadium to reduce some of the incoming burst damage you will receive. Soldier’s self-healing combined with the overhealth you will get from this build will allow you to constantly repair your armor for maximum uptime of damage reduction.

Hunker Down is a solid start that allows you to get some extra sustain in the early rounds. Ideally, you want to start every single engagement with your helix rocket. This will allow you to stay on angles even longer and heal up some of that initial chip damage you might take at the start of your trade.

They have recently changed this item, I’d only pick this up if you don’t have enough money for the other two optional weapon power blues, and I’d usually replace it for the lifesteal green since you have some on this item. Always keep one lifesteal item at all times.
Damage is obviously great for soldier and if you’ve already bought the other two survival blues above, go ahead and pick this up as well.

This item is a must buy on soldier. It will be the very last blue item that you sell come late game to replace with a purple. Due to your constant overhealth and sustain you will almost always have armor so the additional weapon damage reduction and attack speed bonus is always active.

This item provides a little bit of padding in the beginning rounds when you don’t have a lot of sustain/overhealth from the rest of your build yet. It is solely to help you keep the permanent armor buffs / damage reduction active and makes it incredibly hard for the enemy to deal with you. With this you can essentially win every single 1v1 and sometimes 2v1 or 3v1 if your aim, positioning and cooldown usage is good enough.
